newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares extend losses, mood bearish.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares extend losses, mood bearish.

text.p: Lithuania's listless bourse continued its slide Friday, with the official list and group A indices down amid a low turnover of 693,000 litas on the central market.

The bourse's group A index lost 10.33 points, to close at 2127.15, and the index of the official list lost 12.96 points, closing at 908.79. Brokers said there was little reason to hope the market would turn up soon.
"Maybe something will happen in the summer, but I'm not too optimistic," said Saulius Merkys, head broker at Vilfima.
The Klaipeda Sea Shipping company (LISCO) fell to 6.00 litas from 6.08 litas, defying the mood among brokers, who say it looks a bargain.
"I believe at the price of 6.00 or 7.00 litas, LISCO is a good buy for the future," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema.
Birzai Dairy shares moved up to 10.20 litas from 10.01 litas, but one broker said the shares might be too high.
Vilniaus Bank shares also gained, edging up to 235.00 from 230.10 litas.
The bank earlier announced that its first quarter net profit was 10.49 million litas compared to 5.04 million litas for the same period last year.
"What is good about them is that the price doesn't fluctuate very much," Andrejauskas said. "We can call them a blue chip."
